decision.explanation: Both 'diocesan bishop of the Roman Catholic Church' (supported by D2S3) and 'Archbishop of Santiago de Chile' (supported by D1S2 and D1S3) are valid positions held by Simon Hernesby according to the provided sources. These titles refer to the same individual and are not contradictory but rather complementary descriptions of his ecclesiastical roles. The audit records show both are supported directly by the text and do not conflict in referent or scope. 'Bishop of Ashwood' (C2) is not supported by direct evidence and lacks explicit mention of Simon Hernesby.
